article.title: Cedar United update
article.body: Cedar United defeated Westbridge 3-1 yesterday. Their striker scored two goals and the team recorded seven shots on target.

article.title: Cedar United update
article.body: Cedar United confirmed that its captain signed a new two-year contract with the club today.

article.title: Cedar United update
article.body: Cedar United supporters said they felt furious and let down. One supporter said, "I am angry and disappointed with our club."

article.title: Cedar United update
article.body: Cedar United will play Westbridge at 7pm on Friday. The match will be shown on Channel Six. Tickets can be bought at the ground.

article.title: Cedar United update
article.body: Cedar United dismissed head coach Robin Vale on Monday and appointed Jamie Brook as interim head coach.

article.title: Cedar United update
article.body: Cedar United are reportedly negotiating to sign striker Jordan Finch from Westbridge. The report is unconfirmed and no deal has been agreed.

article.title: Cedar United update
article.body: Cedar United ruled out signing Jordan Finch. The club said reports of an agreed transfer were false and negotiations had ended.

article.title: Cedar United update
article.body: Cedar United defender Jordan Finch suffered a torn hamstring in training and will be unavailable for six weeks.

article.title: Lake City Comets update
article.body: Lake City Comets beat the Bay Bears 112-104 on Tuesday. Avery Cole scored 31 points and collected 12 rebounds for the Comets.

article.title: Lake City Comets update
article.body: Lake City Comets traded guard Avery Cole to the Bay Bears in exchange for two draft picks, the teams announced.

article.title: Lake City Comets update
article.body: Lake City Comets guard Avery Cole has been suspended for two games and will miss both upcoming fixtures.

article.title: Lake City Comets update
article.body: Lake City Comets fans cheered and cried with happiness. One fan said, "I feel so proud of this team."

article.title: Lake City Comets update
article.body: Lake City Comets replica jerseys are now on sale. Order today to receive free shipping and a discount on your next purchase.

article.title: Lake City Comets update
article.body: Bay Bears signed a veteran center to a one-year contract. Lake City Comets were not involved in the deal.

article.title: Lake City Comets update
article.body: Lake City Comets hired Dana Reed as their new head coach. The club confirmed the appointment this morning.

article.title: Lake City Comets update
article.body: Lake City Comets signed Avery Cole on a four-year deal. Supporters celebrated outside the arena and chanted his name.

article.title: Summit Wolves update
article.body: Summit Wolves beat the River Hawks 27-17. Quarterback Casey Shaw threw for 280 yards and three touchdowns.

article.title: Summit Wolves update
article.body: Summit Wolves agreed a three-year contract extension with quarterback Casey Shaw, the team announced today.

article.title: Summit Wolves update
article.body: Summit Wolves ruled quarterback Casey Shaw out of Sunday’s game with a shoulder injury. The backup will start.

article.title: Summit Wolves update
article.body: Summit Wolves supporters expressed their frustration and anger. "We feel betrayed by our team," one fan said.

article.title: Summit Wolves update
article.body: Summit Wolves versus River Hawks begins at 4pm on Sunday. Coverage starts an hour earlier on Sports Network.

article.title: Summit Wolves update
article.body: Summit Wolves are reportedly exploring a trade for wide receiver Drew Lane. No agreement has been reached with the River Hawks.

article.title: Summit Wolves update
article.body: Summit Wolves denied reports that Casey Shaw was being traded. The general manager said the quarterback would remain with the team.

article.title: Summit Wolves update
article.body: River Hawks announced a new head coach today. The appointment has nothing to do with Summit Wolves.
